Nighaṇṭu
vedāṅga. List of Vedic words in five Adhyāyas, the first three called Nighaṇṭu Kāṇḍa giving synonyms, the fourth called Naigama Kāṇḍa giving homonyms, mostly rare words, an. the fifth Adhyāya called Devatā Kāṇḍa dealing with the names of deities; this list formed the basis for Yāska's Nirukta.
See C. V. Vaidya, His.. of Skt. Lit. Vol. I. Pt. iii, p.. 96-102; on the two recensions see Intro. p.. 5-14 of Nighaṇṭu an. Nirukta by L. Sarup.
